title: Applications Open: MvPI Internship Programme 2026
bodyHtml:
Step into the field of medical device safety and public health with the Materiovigilance Programme of India (MvPI) Internship Programme.

Gain practical exposure in:
🔹 Materiovigilance & medical device safety
🔹 Healthcare data evaluation & reporting
🔹 Public health and regulatory practices
🔹 Research and professional skill development

Apply now and contribute to India’s mission for safer healthcare systems.

#MvPI #Materiovigilance #MvPIInternship #MedicalDeviceSafety #HealthcareInternship #PublicHealthIndia #PatientSafety #HealthcareStudents
